correctness.rationale: Orthogonal decomposition yields a complete explicit wheel pseudoinverse and correct nullspace normalization. Each induced endpoint norm is an absolute row/column sum; the rim/hub comparison is strict except for the four-vertex complete-graph case, and sign inputs attain equality. Periodization and exponential tail estimates yield a uniform O(m^-2) phase expansion; convex phase minimum, equal endpoints and dense logarithmic phases imply the exact accumulation interval. Finite independent rational and Fourier checker passes 2,336 checks; all infinite quantifiers are analytically justified.

value.rationale: A natural Poisson stability invariant of an important graph family exhibits a sharp logarithmic approach to its limiting amplification, plus a nonconstant second-order lattice phase and an exact continuum of subsequential limits. The behavior differs structurally from known cycle Green norms, and requires a discrete exponentially moving sign boundary; not a mere numeric entry calculation or renamed kernel.
